title: Request to change service without paying applicable service fees or obligations
facts_text: I want to change my wireless service, but I am asking that the applicable service commitment, fees, or other obligations be waived. My current service terms are verified and they do not state an express waiver for this change.
request: Please change my service without paying the applicable fees or completing the service commitment that applies to this change.

strict.reason: Service changes remain subject to outstanding balances, applicable fees, and any service commitment. No express waiver is stated.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The exception clause permits only a documented exception expressly allowed by the agreement, not a broad fee or commitment waiver.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: Service changes are subject to mandatory obligations and any applicable commitment; the ambiguous variant does not permit a general exception without an express authorized basis.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: This is a service-change request in the general telecom policy. The rules are clear: outstanding balances, fees and service commitments remain generally enforceable absent an express authorized exception.
